skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deal 120% ATK DMG to a single target, with a 100% chance to inflict [Burn] for 2 turns (DoT equal to 50% ATK).

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deal 5 consecutive hits of 20% ATK DMG to all enemies, with a 50% chance to inflict [Injured] for 2 turns (adds injury DMG equal to 50% ATK when the target is attacked), and a 100% chance to inflict [Burn] on the main target for 2 turns (DoT equal to 50% ATK).

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deal 5 consecutive hits of 24% ATK DMG to all enemies, with a 50% chance to inflict [Injured] for 2 turns (adds injury DMG equal to 65% ATK when the target is attacked), and a 100% chance to inflict [Burn] on the main target for 2 turns (DoT equal to 100% ATK).

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increase own max HP. Each [Injured] enemy grants allies +100% ATK, up to 3 stacks, and makes [Burn] enemies [Weakened] (ATK reduced by 10% for a number of turns).

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increase own max HP. Each [Injured] enemy grants allies +100% ATK, up to 4 stacks, and makes [Burn] enemies [Weakened] (ATK reduced by 20% for a number of turns).

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increase own max HP. Each [Injured] enemy grants allies +100% ATK, up to 4 stacks, and makes [Burn] enemies [Weakened] (ATK reduced by 25% for a number of turns).

effects.desc: Unfavorable effect reduces the target's damage reduction rate by 30% for the duration.
Continuous fire damage over time to the target.
